---
name: Bug
about: Something behaves differently from how it should
labels: bug
---

## What happens

The observable symptom, before any theory about the cause.

## How to reproduce

The exact steps or command. If it only happens sometimes, say how often.

## Evidence

File and line, the log line, the failing request. What you actually ran.

## What you ruled out

Anything you already checked that turned out fine — it stops the next person
re-checking it.

## How it will be verified

Concretely enough to follow. If the real test is a round trip through the UI,
say so.
